questionEn: Why does chemistry study transformations, and not just properties?
questionUz: Nima uchun kimyo nafaqat xususiyatlarni, balki o'zgarishlarni o'rganadi?
choicesEn: To understand how to obtain the necessary substances and what happens in nature
choicesUz: Kerakli moddalarni qanday olish kerakligini va tabiatda nima sodir bo'lishini tushunish
